limit.sentence: refuse when absMatched >= ceil(0.5 * prior events) i.e. absMatched >= the per-prior absNeed values printed in perPrior (105,105); the escape minimum is priorEvents - absNeed + 1 moved events. The gap side is reported, not a refusal: this driver's fixed waits reproduce gap durations across honest runs, so a gap match is a driver artifact. A forger who moves fewer events but shifts EVERY event by a constant offset escapes this rule — that is the limit.
